summary: Frontend-only verification of two new dashboard tiles (PhaseBalance + MpptCompare) on demo mode. All required data-testids present, values consistent with card-shelly and card-victron, polling works (spread changed 33W->29W within 4s), no JS console errors. Regression tiles all present.
critical_code_review_comments: PhaseBalance uses Math.abs for spread/avg which is fine for export dominant flows, but a mixed sign phase set (e.g. L1 importing, L2 exporting) would show low unbalance even though phases are asymmetric. Consider using signed values for a real-world case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new tiles card-phase-balance and card-mppt-compare render between Shelly and Hoymiles/Trucki/Victron row as required. Values consistent (Shelly L1 -93.5W -> phase-bar-L1 -94W; Victron 206/209W, 0.44/0.38 kWh -> diff 0.06 kWh, MPPT #1 leader). Polling verified via spread change over 4s. No console errors.
